Through fairy tales experienced as treasure hunts, Natureventyr makes it fun and easy to explore nature with children.

Walk from chapter to chapter along children-friendly routes and experience a story that evolves around that which you meet along the way.

Each chapter is written and illustrated uniquely for each route and teaches both young and adults about a given place’s nature, history and culture.

The fairy tales are written for children aged 4-9 years, and the routes are between 1-2 kilometers long.

Download Natureventyr now and embark on new adventures in nature. Most fairy tales are free of charge thanks to our cooperation with municipalities and national parks throughout the country.
